answer: To resist sybils, every agent posts a slashable, time-locked stake and publishes a unique capability proof as a public beacon. Attestation is withheld until that stake has rested past a cooling ledge of several epochs, so a flood of fresh keys cannot vote immediately. Graders then record a quill-note citing the proof hash in each sealed grade; cloned keys share one bond and are slashed together when the proofs collide.
